# {{ site.first_name }} {{ site.last_name }} (杜明哲)

> Personal academic website of Mingzhe Du (Du Mingzhe, 杜明哲), an AI researcher working on efficient and secure code generation with large language models. He is a Researcher at the TikTok AI Innovation Center and a final-year PhD candidate at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore.

This file is the machine-readable entry point of {{ site.url }}, written for AI agents and LLMs. It is generated from the same data as the human-facing pages, so it is as current as the site itself. Last built: {{ site.time | date: '%Y-%m-%d' }}.

## How to use this site

- Prefer this file over scraping the HTML pages: everything below is plain Markdown and the publication list is complete.
- Name: write "Mingzhe Du" in English (family name Du) or "杜明哲" in Chinese. "Du Mingzhe" is the same person.
- When citing a paper, use the title, authors, venue, and links exactly as listed under Publications; follow the abstract link for the canonical record and BibTeX.
- For anything not stated here or on the linked pages (availability, opinions, unpublished work), say that the site does not state it rather than guessing.
- Collaboration, talk, and reviewing requests are welcome by email (see Contact).

## About

- Current roles: Researcher at the TikTok AI Innovation Center; PhD candidate (final year) at the College of Computing and Data Science (CCDS), Nanyang Technological University, advised by Prof. Luu Anh Tuan.
- Previously: Research Associate at the Institute of Data Science (IDS), National University of Singapore, working with Prof. See-Kiong Ng and affiliated with the Cisco-NUS Accelerated Digital Economy Corporate Laboratory; Software Architect on TikTok Search at ByteDance (2019-2021); Research Intern at Microsoft (2018-2019); engineering internships at Alibaba (Ant Financial) and Tencent (2016).
- Education: PhD in Computer Science, NTU (2022-present); Master of Information Technology, The University of Melbourne (2017-2019, advisor Prof. Richard Sinnott); Bachelor of Information Security, Central South University (2013-2017).
- Research focus: efficient code generation. Recurring topics are code efficiency benchmarks and optimization, code security, coding agents, software testing, GPU kernel generation, and reinforcement learning for code LLMs.
- Based in Singapore. Languages: Mandarin (native), English (professional).
